versions.title: Batch transcription and CLI bug fix
highlights: Batch transcription — select multiple recordings and transcribe them all with one click
English-only models added: tiny.en, base.en, small.en, medium.en, and distil-large-v3 — faster and more accurate for English recordings
Fixed bmeeting CLI not launching on macOS 26.6.2 (Tahoe)
BoringMeeting is now open source under GPL-3.0 — read, build and contribute on GitHub
New links in Settings → About: source code, issue tracker and privacy policy
Unsigned builds are also published on GitHub Releases

versions.title: Bug fixes and stability improvements
highlights: Bug fixes and stability improvements

versions.title: Trim recordings, CLI integration, and more
highlights: Split audio streams is now on by default — separate mic and system audio for better transcription accuracy
bmeeting CLI — manage meetings from the terminal or connect to AI tools and scripts
Select audio source before transcription — pick system audio only to avoid echo when listening without headphones
Auto-delete old recordings — set a retention period in Settings to keep storage clean
Transcription time estimate now adapts to your Mac's actual speed
Trim recordings — cut the end of a recording if you forgot to stop in time
Minor UI polish — cleaner transcript area, slightly more readable status text
Recording button position — move the Start Recording panel to the bottom of the sidebar via Settings → General
Minor internal improvements

versions.title: Bug fixes and stability improvements
highlights: Fixed toggle in What's New screen not responding to clicks
Added Hide menu bar icon setting (useful when screen sharing if you do not want others to see the recording icon in the menu bar)

versions.title: Better transcription controls and a more stable interface
highlights: Improved transcription model management and status display
Small performance and UI stability improvements
Added beta feature: split transcription for system audio and microphone streams
versions.details: Thanks for using BoringMeeting. As always, your recordings and transcriptions stay local on your device.
